WebSocketContext.tsx:246-256 calls service.connect() when auth.accessToken changes, but lib/websocket.ts:292-294 short-circuits if socket.readyState === OPEN — so a refreshed JWT is never propagated into the WS URL. Stale token remains until the server expires it and closes the socket. Fix: on token change, disconnect()+connect() (as reconnect() already does), or compare tokens.

lib/errorHandler.ts:53-133 ships hardcoded English titles/messages ("Authentication Required", "Please log in to continue.", etc.) and lib/errorHandler.ts:439-464 (formatValidationErrors, formatFieldName) produce English-only field labels. ppt-web is supposed to be i18n-enabled (react-i18next 16 in package.json); all user-visible error copy bypasses the translation layer.

lib/api.ts:281 `export default getApiClient();` instantiates the axios client at module-import time with no token getter and no onUnauthorized callback. The whole module is currently only consumed by its own test file (no production import found), so it's dead code in app paths — but it's a live footgun: any future `import api from '../lib/api'` would silently use the unconfigured instance and bypass the AuthContext token interceptor. Either delete the module or remove the default export.
